inputs.note: peaks = find_peaks(total_persistence) from the compute_total_persistence_seed45 fixture (this dataset yields exactly one real peak, at index 1 into sizes/total_persistence -- a small but genuine multi-layer case; the phase-6 n80 tree's persistence curve is monotone and yields ZERO peaks, so it can't exercise this function meaningfully). Peaks sorted by persistence descending (np.argsort(...)[::-1] -- ties broken by argsort's stable order, i.e. original ascending-index order among equal values). For each candidate peak in that order: compute jaccard-based estimate_cluster_similarity against every ALREADY-selected peak's birth size; reject (skip) if similarity > threshold for ANY already-selected peak, else accept. Stops early once max_layers peaks are selected.
